# Academic Harness (engine)

Vendored Python engine for writing, revising, and verifying academic LaTeX
documents. It lives inside the dsh-researchcraft plugin
(`vendor/academic-harness`). A local `.venv` next to this tree is created on
first ResearchCraft start. Nothing is installed into `$DSH_HOME`. Native
`ah_*` tools drive it.

Upstream: https://github.com/raktim-mondol/academic-harness

This copy is the engine only. Pi is not required.
